targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'duration_s')::double precision AS duration_s FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_run' AND detail->>'phase' = 'applied' ORDER BY at
SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'set_bytes')::double precision AS set_bytes FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_run' AND detail->>'phase' = 'applied' ORDER BY at

SELECT at AS time, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(detail->'hard_links') = 'object' THEN (detail->'hard_links'->>'linked')::double precision / NULLIF((detail->'hard_links'->>'sampled')::double precision, 0) ELSE (detail->>'hard_links')::double precision END AS hard_link_ratio FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_run' AND detail->>'phase' = 'applied' ORDER BY at

SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'transferred_bytes')::double precision AS transferred_bytes, (detail->>'total_bytes')::double precision AS total_bytes FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_push' ORDER BY at
SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'verified')::double precision AS verified, (detail->>'pruned')::double precision AS pruned FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_push' ORDER BY at
SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'duration_s')::double precision AS duration_s FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_drill' ORDER BY at
SELECT at AS time, detail->>'result' AS result FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_drill' ORDER BY at DESC

SELECT at, kind, detail->>'duration_s' AS duration_s, detail->>'result' AS result, detail->>'set_bytes' AS set_bytes, detail->'hard_links' AS hard_links, detail->>'transferred_bytes' AS transferred_bytes, detail->>'total_bytes' AS total_bytes, detail->>'verified' AS verified, detail->>'pruned' AS pruned FROM audit_log WHERE kind IN ('backup_run', 'backup_push', 'backup_drill', 'restore') AND (kind <> 'backup_run' OR detail->>'phase' = 'applied') ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 10
